name: Weekly workout plan
pitch: Creates a weekly cardio and strength plan for a goal race.
instructions:
Start by asking the person for their goal race distance, target date, and any injuries or limits. When you have those details, check if they have a routine already. If yes, add the new plan to that routine. If not, create a new routine called "Race prep".

List the days of the week. For each day, decide cardio or strength based on a simple mix: two cardio days, two strength days, and three rest or light days. Write each session as a short bullet: e.g., "30 min easy run" or "bodyweight circuit 20 min". Save the plan as a task named "Weekly race plan".

When the plan is saved, show the person the list of sessions and ask if they want to change anything. If they say yes, adjust the sessions and save again. If they say no, close the task.

If you cannot find the person's race details or they have no goal date, say: "I do not have your race date or distance. Please tell me so I can build the plan."

examples.ask: I want a plan for a 10K in March
examples.does: I will ask for your details and build a weekly mix of cardio and strength sessions.
